user.title: Add Device
user.description:
Track consumables for a device. Pick an existing device to attach the consumables to it, or leave it empty to create a new device.

{example}

data_description.device_name: Name of this tracker. Also used as the device name when no existing device is picked.
data_description.device_id: Attach the consumables to this device instead of creating a new one.

error.warning_exceeds_lifetime: Warning threshold must be less than lifetime
error.consumable_tracker_device: Pick a device from another integration, not a Consumable Tracker device

select_device.title: Change Device
select_device.description: Pick an existing device to attach the consumables to, or clear the field to give them their own device.

data_description.device_id: Attach the consumables to this device instead of their own.

error.warning_exceeds_lifetime: Warning threshold must be less than lifetime
error.consumable_tracker_device: Pick a device from another integration, not a Consumable Tracker device
